blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Tuesday conducted a final walkthrough at the Philippine International Convention Center (PICC) in Pasay City ahead of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit on Nov. 15 to 17. The walkthrough was aimed at ensuring that the facilities are ready for the arrival of leaders from 11 Asean member states and nine dialogue partner countries. READ: Palace: Clearing ops ahead of Asean for ‘safety’ of delegates Marcos personally inspected the PICC, as well as the World Trade Center, which will serve as the International Media Center for at least 5,000 media delegates from different countries.
